title: MMKB-RAG: A Multi-Modal Knowledge-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework
authors: Zihan Ling; Zhiyao Guo; Yixuan Huang; Yi An; Shuai Xiao; Jinsong Lan; Xiaoyong Zhu; Bo Zheng
why_relevant: Proposes a multi-modal RAG framework that decides when to retrieve, filters irrelevant documents, and reranks for consistency, addressing noisy retrieval and retrieval control in MLLMs.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on multi-modal VQA; robustness contributions are incremental filtering/self-RAG-style tagging rather than novel calibration analysis.
suggested_section: Calibration and control: when to retrieve and filter
